fields.name: run
fields.coerce: tested as true or false: any truthy value means `true`
fields.description: `true`: your code runs. Falsy or missing: your code does not run.

responses.name: Update
responses.when: Always when you have a character. There is no `game_response`.
responses.summary: Your character (`u+cid`) with the new `code` flag. Other clients see `code` in the entity of your character.
